title: olearia phlogopappa subsp. gunniana
intro:
Olearia phlogopappa subsp. gunniana, commonly known as Prickly Tree Daisy, is a flowering plant species native to Tasmania. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Olearia phlogopappa subsp. gunniana include soothing and calming effects, making it useful in treating anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.

Note: Please be aware that while this plant has potential health benefits, its use should be guided by a healthcare professional.
